rv.q: BrightSide has delivered an amazing production that should be seen and shared.
BrightSide’s entertaining rendition of Jesus Christ Superstar is a must-see production and well worth the trip to the western suburbs.

Guitarist extraordinaire Paul Compton takes the spotlight centerstage, captivating the audience with the ominous opening chords of the show’s overture that sets the mood and fills the entire theatre with sound.
I commend their efforts to achieve this extraordinary feat; however, it ultimately proved too overwhelming for this mid-size theater company.

cn.t: BrightSide Theatre's production earns praise for its powerful rock score and accomplished onstage band, though critical reception remains mixed on the overall execution of this intimate staging.
